title: views
description: One list of items in the file and the views over it. `fields` says which item key plays which role — id, title, status, start, end, previous, parent — and `views` which views the file offers, each over the items its filter keeps. Without `views`, the roles decide: a table always, a kanban by `status`, a calendar by `start` (and `end`), a gantt by `start`, `end` and `previous` or `parent`, a dependency tree by `previous`. A page is a view the file names with a Nunjucks `template` of its own, rendering the view's items as HTML. Read only; which view is open is kept for the session.

fields.description: Which item key plays which role. A role absent means the views that need it are absent; `id` and `title` default to keys of those names.

id.description: The key that identifies an item (default `id`) — what `previous` and `parent` name.

title.description: The key an item is labelled by (default `title`).

status.description: The key that is a kanban column — allows the Kanban view.

start.description: The key that is the start date, `YYYY-MM-DD` — allows the Calendar view; with `end` and `previous` or `parent`, the Gantt.

end.description: The key that is the end date, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

previous.description: The key naming what comes before — one id or a list of ids — allows the Tree view; with the dates, the Gantt.

parent.description: The key naming the one item this one is part of — the gantt nests it under that item, and a parent without dates spans its children.

columns.description: The statuses in order, for the Kanban; absent, the values found are the columns, first seen first. Needs a `status` role.

views.description: The views to offer, in this order, each over the items its filter keeps. Absent: one view of every kind the roles allow, the table first.

kind.description: Which view; its roles must be named under `fields` (a kanban needs `status`, a calendar `start`, a gantt `start`, `end` and `previous` or `parent`, a tree `previous`). A page needs no role and has a `template` of its own.

label.description: The button's text; the kind's name when absent.

filter.description: Clauses over the items' own keys, every one of which must hold — the suite's one vocabulary. Items that fail are hidden for this view only.

sort.description: The order, first key first: `{field, dir: asc|desc}` or a field name.

limit.description: At most this many items, after the filter and the sort.

template.description: A page view's Nunjucks template, whose output is the view. It is handed `items` — the view's items after its filter, sort and limit, each a mapping of its own keys as written, a date as `YYYY-MM-DD` — with `title` (the document's), `fields` (the role → key map), `columns` (the kanban's) and `view` (its `key` and `label`). A page view only.

partials.description: The templates a page view's `include`, `import`, `from … import` and `extends` name, by name. A page view only.

additionalProperties.description: A Nunjucks template, as a block string.

items.description: One item — its fields as they are. The key playing `id` is required and unique; the keys playing `start` and `end` are dates; the key playing `previous` is an id or a list of ids, the key playing `parent` one id, of items in this file.
The list itself. `items: []` is an empty one.

field.description: An item key, or a dot path into a nested mapping.

value.description: One value, or a list — any of them for a text op, `[lo, hi]` for `between`, the set for `in`/`not_in`.

x-studio-roles.title: the label
x-studio-roles.status: a column of the Kanban; matched case-insensitively against `columns`
x-studio-roles.start: a date; a value that is not one is a problem
x-studio-roles.end: a date; before `start` is a problem
x-studio-roles.previous: ids of items in this file; the item itself, an unknown id or a cycle is a problem
x-studio-roles.parent: one id of an item in this file; the item itself, an unknown id or a cycle is a problem
